in_marathi.name: Preyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Creatures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Preyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Preyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Prajapati', which refers to the Creator God of the universe in Hindu mythology. In Hindu tradition, Prajapati is the lord of all beings and the creator of the universe. Therefore, Preyansh is a name that symbolizes power, creation, and the divine.
